items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: What do you think about Joe Frazier and those other people?

ctx.x: brought that band to New York and Walter Page - was Basie in that band that came here?

Walter Page did not join it till 1932. When Bennie came to New York City he upset New York City with "Driving Me Crazy," which was Moten's Swing they played, then. And that's the time when they had the 5-band tour with Blanche Calloway, Johnson (Happy Pals) (Hakapais?), Chick Webb. Everybody would get in the buses and make the tour down through . . . . . . You know how things were. You have somebody go around and say, "There's going to be a battle of bands," and the musicians just splitting up the money. You…
